map.岩石 RQD 指标计算 使用指南: Rock RQD Index Calculation User Guide
map.根据岩芯段长度计算岩石质量指标 RQD，并按 Deere 分级标准评价岩体质量。: Compute the rock quality designation RQD from core segment lengths and evaluate rock mass quality by the Deere grading standard.
map.RQD = Σ(长度 ≥ 阈值 的完整岩芯段) / 钻孔总长度 × 100%: RQD = sum(complete core segments with length >= threshold) / total borehole length x 100%
map.岩芯段在裂隙、破碎带处断开；仅计入长度不小于阈值（默认 100 mm）的完整段，: Core segments break at fractures and crushed zones; only complete segments no shorter than the threshold (default 100 mm) are counted, and this tool grades rock mass quality by the Deere standard.
map.岩体质量评价：录入每回次≥阈值的完整岩芯段长度，算 RQD 并按 Deere 标: Rock mass quality evaluation: enter the length of complete core segments >= threshold for each run and compute RQD, grading by the Deere standard
map.边坡/基坑设计：RQD 是岩体质量分级（RMR/Q）的基础输入: Slope/foundation pit design: RQD is the basic input for rock mass classification (RMR/Q)
map.钻孔验收：现场快速核算 RQD，判断岩芯采取质量是否达标: Borehole acceptance: compute RQD quickly on site to judge whether core recovery quality meets the requirement
map.：算法：RQD = Σ(长度 ≥ 阈值的有效岩芯段) / 钻孔总长度 × 100: : Algorithm: RQD = sum(effective core segments with length >= threshold) / total borehole length x 100% (core segments converted to mm by the selected unit mm/cm/m, and total borehole length converted to mm). Deere grading: RQD >=90% very good, 75-90% good, 50-75% fair, 25-50% poor, <25% very poor. The default effective segment threshold is 100 mm (changeable).
map.：例：钻孔总长 2.0m，岩芯段（mm）120, 85, 250, 60, 18: : Example: total borehole length 2.0 m, core segments (mm) 120, 85, 250, 60, 180, 95, 310, 40, 150, threshold 100 mm. Effective segments (>=100 mm) are 120+250+180+310+150 = 1010 mm, total effective core length 1.010 m, RQD = 1010/2000 x 100% = 50.5%, 5 of 9 segments effective, judged 'Fair'. With a good-quality hole instead: total length 5.0 m with 10 segments all 400 mm gives effective 4000 mm, RQD = 4000/5000 x 100% = 80.0%, judged 'Good'.
map.数学上若有效岩芯总长超过钻孔总长会出现 >100%，通常是岩芯段长度录入重复或单: Mathematically, if the total effective core length exceeds the total borehole length you get >100%, which usually means core segment lengths were entered twice or a unit conversion error. Check whether the cumulative segments exceed the total advance; physically the RQD upper limit is 100%.
map.RQD 低就代表岩体差吗？: Does a low RQD always mean poor rock mass?
map.RQD 主要反映岩芯完整程度，受裂隙密度与产状影响；强风化但完整的软岩 RQD: RQD mainly reflects core intactness and is affected by fracture density and attitude; strongly weathered but intact soft rock can also give a high RQD. It should be judged together with RMR, the Q system and field description, and rock mass cannot be classified on RQD alone.
